title.zh: 授予Felix Maronilla，Jr.在阿尔拜省Libon电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Felix Maronilla, Jr., a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in Libon, Albay
title.orig: An Act Granting Felix Maronilla, Jr., a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in Libon, Albay

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_256_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to Felix Maronilla, Jr., for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the limits of the municipality of Libon, Province of Albay.

It is expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the plant and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender its franchise and will turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1948.
